subject.title: feat: trace Claude Code CLI model calls

question: Should Claude CLI attempt-level telemetry use the existing harness lifecycle, a new CLI-turn lifecycle, or intentionally broaden the public `model.call` contract beyond individual provider requests?
rationale: The implementation is mechanically bounded, but choosing the permanent public telemetry unit affects documented semantics, dashboards, GenAI metrics, and future harness integrations.

options.title: Use turn-level telemetry
options.body: Keep `model.call` per-request and represent Claude CLI attempts through `harness.run` or a dedicated CLI-turn lifecycle.

options.title: Broaden model-call semantics
options.body: Intentionally redefine `model.call` to permit synthetic aggregate turns and update documentation, exporters, metrics, tests, and consumer expectations accordingly.

options.title: Pause the feature
options.body: Do not add synthetic tracing until Claude Code exposes trustworthy individual request boundaries.

recommendation.title: Use turn-level telemetry
recommendation.body: Keep `model.call` per-request and represent Claude CLI attempts through `harness.run` or a dedicated CLI-turn lifecycle.

likelyOwner.reason: The available history most strongly connects this person to the current diagnostics, model-call, GenAI, and harness telemetry contracts.
